rule: Addresses of records that are no longer published on their own. Each keeps its address, which leads to the record that now covers it, through a page that is never indexed and names the target as its canonical address (scripts/yfie/render.py, moved_page; gate RC-19 in scripts/validate.py). An entry is added only by an owner decision recorded in audit/OWNER_DECISIONS_*.md, and its source route is removed from the Master (02 and 06) in the same transaction.
